title: Virtual Sensing to Enable Real-Time Monitoring of Inaccessible Locations & Unmeasurable Parameters
abstract: arXiv:2412.00107v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Real-time monitoring of safety-critical interior states is an open problem across energy, environmental and industrial systems where direct instrumentation is infeasible. Approaches based on governing equations, discrete state vectors or fixed sensor locations cannot deliver mesh-independent, field-level reconstruction at arbitrary interior coordinates in real time. Here we introduce neural operator-based virtual sensing, a framework for recovering inaccessible interior fields from sparse boundary measurements, instantiated with MIMONet, a multi-input, multi-output neural operator that fuses heterogeneous inputs and decodes coupled fields through a shared latent representation. Across three engineering-grade evaluations of escalating complexity - confined recirculating flow, pressurized water reactor subchannels and compact power-system heat exchangers - MIMONet attains relative reconstruction error below 5% with sub-millisecon

translated_title: 虚拟传感实现难以到达位置与不可测量参数的实时监测
translated_abstract: 对安全关键内部状态的实时监测是能源、环境和工业系统中的开放问题，在这些系统中直接仪表化不可行。基于控制方程、离散状态向量或固定传感器位置的方法无法在任意内部坐标处实时提供网格无关的场级重建。本文介绍了基于神经算子的虚拟传感框架，用于从稀疏边界测量中恢复不可达内部场，并通过MIMONet（一种多输入多输出神经算子）实现，该算子融合异构输入并通过共享潜在表示解码耦合场。在三个复杂度递增的工程级评估中——受限再循环流动、压水堆子通道和紧凑型电力系统换热器——MIMONet实现了相对重建误差低于5%，且亚毫秒级运行。
tldr: 本文提出基于神经算子的虚拟传感框架MIMONet，从稀疏边界测量实时重建不可达内部场，在三个工程案例中误差低于5%且亚毫秒完成。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MIMONet, a neural operator-based virtual sensing framework that reconstructs inaccessible interior fields from sparse boundary measurements in real time, achieving below 5% error across three engineering cases with sub-millisecond speed.
